system.description:
Take a Reload action to apply this ammo to any rifle and place 2 tokens on this card.

Discard 1 token for each subsequent attacks using that rifle. If the attack marks any Hit Points, the Tracker Rounds inject a tracker into the body of the target, that cannot be removed without a narrative action by the GM. The tracker can be detected within 3 miles.
